pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

7. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

12. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Roles of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — The speed of the music

2. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. D — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — Red, blue, and yellow

9. D — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Components of Creative Arts and Sports; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
